connector.name: MCP Server by tickerbot
connector.registryDescription: The stock market, in SQL - scan, replay, or subscribe across ~12k US tickers and top 100 cryptos.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.tickerbot.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tickerbot account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.name: TICKERBOT_API_KEY
env.description: Tickerbot API key (tb_live_… or tb_test_…). Get one at https://tickerbot.io/dashboard.
